correctness.rationale: Theorem 12 in arxiv:2104.06756v4 gives the exact positive rank-one Gram structure at Barba equality. Independent row/column sign normalizations yield simultaneous Gram forms and invertible A with nonzero inverse entries. The zero-cofactor argument rules out non-sign cube determinant maximizers. The exact pair-incidence counts follow from column sums q and dot product 1 and produce the stated induced norm for all real parameters. Zonotope generator determinants have the unequal ratios q:q:1, excluding affinely regularity and invoking Ostrovskii Theorem 3.1. Theorem 16 supplies infinitely many dimensions; symbolic identities and a rational n=5 example were checked. No infinite proof is inferred from finite tests.

originality.rationale: Full-text Ostrovskii 2011 gives the exact MVSE criterion and explicitly leaves odd ℓ1 orders beyond n=3 and Hadamard orders to maximal-determinant analysis. The later determinant survey gives Barba-tight Gram matrices and an infinite family but no Auerbach/MVSE implication. The proven all-maximizer cofactor rigidity, universal exact planar norm and non-regularity make a substantive unreported bridge. Exact relevant searches of mathematical records found no covering claim; novelty is best-knowledge, not guaranteed.

value.rationale: Resolves the non-parallelepipedal MVSE question in a new infinite family of odd-dimensional real ℓ1 spaces left open in the 2011 paper and classifies the exact common two-vector norm for every lower Auerbach basis. The family extends beyond the known Hadamard-order class, and the rigidity mechanism is structural rather than a parameter substitution or isolated numerical case.
